verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists sync integrations that pull work from other tools into Asana: one-way or two-way sync with Jira, Azure DevOps, monday.com, Wrike and others, a Jira Cloud Data Sync, and GitLab and Bitbucket sync (Bitbucket explicitly including assignees). This makes a consolidated view possible, but only by mirroring external tasks into Asana through directory integrations rather than a native unified cross-tool inbox. Missing for 10: evidence of a native unified 'my assigned tasks' view across tools, explicit assignee mapping for most connectors, clarity on whether connectors are first-party, and hands-on corroboration.
